lines: Good afternoon. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.
Carney meets Trump in China, says Canada’s U.S. trade ‘much more complex’ than China, The Canadian Press reports.
The parliamentary budget officer is questioning the federal government’s vow to spend less and invest more, The Canadian Press reports.

Democrats nominated Hakeem Jeffries on Wednesday to be speaker of the House, as he brushed past skeptics and was on track to make history as the nation’s first Black lawmaker with the gavel, The Associated Press reports.
After a 13-year wait, ‘Grand Theft Auto VI’ arrives with enormous hype and expectations, The Associated Press reports.
Wall Street is wobbling Wednesday, as Nvidia and other stocks tied to artificial intelligence keep swinging on uncertainty about how much strength is left in the AI boom, The Canadian Press reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
